intro: Belize has the second-largest barrier reef in the world and large areas of protected rainforest.

chapters.title: The reef
text: The Belize Barrier Reef is a World Heritage site. The Great Blue Hole, a giant underwater sinkhole about 300 m wide, is a famous diving spot.

chapters.title: Forests and caves
text: The Maya Mountains rise in the south. Cockscomb Basin was the world's first jaguar reserve. Actun Tunichil Muknal is a cave with ancient Maya remains.

keyTerms.meaning: A hole formed when rock dissolves.
